requirements.accept: Populated v3 to v4 upgrade preserves every existing row, payload, graph and ledger; failed upgrade rolls back.
requirements.reject: Silent old-schema mutation or promotion of an unverified database.

requirements.accept: An explicit immutable single-parent correction relates two issued versions of the same assessment identity; branches remain visible.
Atomic issue plus correction declaration; retain source, reason, canonical UTC recorded time and exact lexical values including UNKNOWN.
requirements.reject: Partial issued bundle, missing provenance, overwritten old value or coerced missing value.

requirements.accept: Bound queries return original and corrected branches separately; correction versions are not independent corroboration.
requirements.reject: Silent latest-wins selection or source truth/actual occurrence inferred from correction storage.

requirements.accept: Backup/reopen/dump restoration validates schema, ledger and stored semantics; exact native RDF from old and new version graphs is preserved.
requirements.reject: Tampered restored lineage accepted or application correction exported as a native ontology property.

policy.scope: Same-identity assessment correction only; not arbitrary assertion/scenario/source admission.
policy.correction_predicate: Application metadata only; no native predicate added.
policy.declaration: Append immutable declaration after both versions are issued; declaration time must be no earlier than either recorded assessment time. No claim of causal/event/interval order.
policy.branching: One parent per corrected version; many children per prior version. No automatic latest or authoritative branch.
policy.source: Correction declaration source is distinct from assessment/result sources; none establishes independent support.
policy.rdf: Existing native named-graph projection is unchanged; correction lineage remains SQL metadata.
